text:
maya: Quick Q — where can I find per-pool metrics for pool-eu-west-2-prod-3? Need GPU/CPU util, KV cache hit rate, queue length, and the autoscaler timeline. Trying to tune alerts and avoid noise.

devops-sara: Grafana -> Pool Overview has that. Use the pool var to filter: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/8u2k/pool-overview?var-pool=pool-eu-west-2-prod-3 :thumbsup:

devops-sara: Panels to check: GPU utilization (per-pool), KV cache hit rate, Autoscaler timeline, Request queue length. Example PromQLs (filter with pool label):
```
avg_over_time(gpu_utilization_seconds_total{pool="pool-eu-west-2-prod-3"}[5m])
sum(cache_hits_total{pool="pool-eu-west-2-prod-3"}) / sum(cache_requests_total{pool="pool-eu-west-2-prod-3"})
sum(request_queue_length{pool="pool-eu-west-2-prod-3"})
```

devops-sara: For logs, Loki stream (look for autoscaler events / eviction/scale):
```
{pool="pool-eu-west-2-prod-3"} |= "scale-up" or |= "eviction"
```
Jaeger traces: service=autoscaler-service + tag pool=pool-eu-west-2-prod-3 -> https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search?service=autoscaler-service&tags.pool=pool-eu-west-2-prod-3

jess: thx — I have a small infra PR to adjust the alert thresholds, tagging you @devops-sara. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/1204

devops-sara: Proposed alert tweaks (draft):
- PoolHighGPU: when avg_over_time(gpu_utilization{pool="$POOL"}[5m]) > 0.75 for 10m
- PoolQueueBacklog: when sum(request_queue_length{pool="$POOL"}) > 40 for 5m

devops-sara: Also propose a composite rule to reduce noise: trigger paging only if both GPU>75% (10m) AND queue>40 (5m). Otherwise send a slack warning. Will open a ticket INF-804 to track rollout across pools.

tom: quick question — how long do we keep high-res metrics? need 90d for trend analysis.

devops-sara: High-res (15s) stored 7d; we downsample to 1m/5m for 90d. If you need raw older than 7d we can export to long-term storage (costly) — file a request in INF-806.

luke: fyi, composite alert is good — reduces flapping. also consider increasing evaluation window for GPU to 15m for very spiky workloads.

devops-sara: noted. I'll add an opt-in flag for longer eval windows per-pool in the PR.

infra-bot: deploy "infra/alerts@main" succeeded — build 20250321-9a3f (deployed by CI) :rocket:

jess: I'll review #1204 today, leave comments if anything looks off.

devops-sara: Opening INF-804 now to track the alert rollout + a follow-up INF-807 for docs (dashboard links + query snippets). Ping me if you want the threshold changed for this pool specifically.

maya: awesome, thanks all — I'll check the Grafana dashboard and the PR. Will report back if alerts still noisy.

luke: thanks — small ask: can we add the autoscaler decision logs to the Loki panel (reason strings)? that helped in past incidents.

devops-sara: yep will include decision logs in Loki query and add a small dashboard panel. Adding to INF-807.

maya: perfect. :white_check_mark:
